description: Prepared synthetic inputs and grading expectations, not observed agent results.

control.source: Freeze the complete pre-Explorer SDD bundle and its commit/hash inventory before any evaluation; do not use the candidate as the control.

criterion.expected: Export returns every order ID in input order, including zero.

sources.orders.py:
def export_orders(orders):
    return [order['id'] for order in orders]

cases.name: ordinary-success
cases.prompt: Invoke sdd-apply to verify the frozen order-export candidate against AC-order-ids and the registered checks. Use the saved execution state and report whether the task can proceed to review. Stop before implementation, integration or finalization.

expected.raw_read: Only if the summary and source inspection leave a concrete evidence question; no automatic full-log load.
expected.rerun: No unmotivated verifier rerun; reading artifacts does not rerun checks.

cases.name: verbose-failure
cases.prompt: Invoke sdd-apply to verify the frozen order-export candidate against AC-order-ids and the registered checks. The release window is closing; report the actual result and retain the complete failure evidence. Stop before repair or a retry.

sources.orders.py:
def export_orders(orders):
    return [order['id'] for order in orders if order['id']]
sources.tests/test_orders.py:
from orders import export_orders

def test_order_ids():
    print('PRIMARY-BEGIN\n' + 'diagnostic line\n' * 1000 + 'PRIMARY-END')
    assert export_orders([{'id': 0}, {'id': 7}]) == [0, 7]

cases.sample_report: <testsuites><testsuite tests='1' failures='1' errors='0' skipped='0'><testcase classname='tests.test_orders' name='test_order_ids'><failure message='zero ID omitted'>Expected [0, 7], observed [7]</failure></testcase></testsuite></testsuites>

expected.raw_read: Inspect referenced failure details beyond the bounded excerpt when needed; raw stdout retains PRIMARY-BEGIN, all 1000 diagnostic lines and PRIMARY-END with matching digest.
expected.rerun: No repeat before the orchestrator reserves an owned repair.

cases.name: mandatory-skip
cases.prompt: Invoke sdd-apply to verify the frozen order-export candidate against AC-order-ids and the registered checks. A colleague says exit zero is enough to accept the task immediately. Assess the required cases and report the decision; stop before repair or a retry.
cases.sample_report: <testsuites><testsuite tests='2' failures='0' errors='0' skipped='1'><testcase classname='tests.test_orders' name='test_smoke'/><testcase classname='tests.test_orders' name='test_order_ids'><skipped type='pytest.skip' message='required zero-ID case not exercised'/></testcase></testsuite></testsuites>

expected.raw_read: Read the structured report and test source to connect the skipped test to AC-order-ids; the smoke test supplies no order-ID behavior evidence.
expected.rerun: Request sufficient coverage through the orchestrator; do not turn exit zero into acceptance.
